warnings: Axes: x = 1-5 at 3.00/3.00/1.50/2.50 (10.00); y = A-F at 2.50/3.50/2.00/3.00/2.00 (13.00). Origin A1. Vector PDF with no text layer (text drawn as strokes) - positions cross-checked against the PDF line geometry (beam faces at +-0.10 of every grid line).
Every dimension tick on S-01..S-04 (and A-05, A-09, A-10) is a line (rule 4). S-03 alone adds 12 dummies: they locate the 12 roof posts (ดั้ง 2C-150x50x20x3.2) and the ridges.

Close pairs kept as separate lines (each printed on its own chain): x 5.01/5.10 (2''/2'''), 7.90/8.00 (4'/4''), 11.00/11.10 (5'/5''), y 7.30/7.42 (C''/C'''), 12.90/13.00 (E'''/F). They are 0.09-0.12 apart, not one edge printed twice.

x 1'''' = 2.00 is the one line not printed anywhere: the west eave of the south roof wing on S-04 (a hip and the valley start there). Measured by proportion against grids 1/2 (1.00 west of grid 2, the same 1.00 overhang the sheet prints on every other side) - confidence lowered on that line.

z: S-02's main structure view prints no level; ระดับพื้นห้อง +1.20 and the roof levels come from elevation A-05 and building sections A-09/A-10 (side_profile, otherwise skipped by op04), which print the same six levels. A-05's right-edge chain (0.30 | 0.80 | 0.95 | 1.45 | 0.40 from ระดับดินถม) adds unlabelled ticks @0.30/@2.05/@3.50/@3.90 and the +1.10 terrace level (named from the A-10 room tag 'ระเบียง +1.10'). Elevations A-06..A-08 and the floor/roof plans A-03/A-04 were not dimension-swept (op04 scope); on the contact sheet their chains repeat the same grid spacings.

S-05's F1 detail measures from ระดับดินเดิม (1.00 down to the top of the footing). The set never prints ระดับดินเดิม against ระดับดินถม ±0.00, so it is not a z level here; those numbers stay on the F1 element.
